scripts.build:standalone: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.standalone.config.ts && node scripts/package-standalone.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:standalone && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:update: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/integration.spec.ts
scripts.test:accessibility: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:standalone: npm run build:standalone && playwright test tests/e2e/standalone.spec.ts --project=chrome-1920
scripts.test:routes: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/route-ids.spec.ts
